::: {#exr-boy-forgive-pen}
Showing a few natural splines. They head off linearly instead of as x^2 or x^3 or higher order. Return 

```{r}
#| label: C07-adyac
x <- seq(0, 1, length=51)
foo <- splines::ns(x, df=2)
plot(foo[,1])
plot(foo[,2])
foo <- splines::ns(x, df=3)
plot(foo[,2])
plot(foo[,1])
plot(foo[,3])
```


:::
